bio:
Josephine R. Heffernan (30 Dec 1883 - 8 Mar 1984) graduated as a nurse from St. Joseph's Hospital, Reading, in 1906 (Wilkes-Barre Record, 31 Mar 1906), married George J. Wagner, moved to California, and died at Alameda aged 100.

FamilySearch identifies her husband as George Julius Wagner (b. California 27 Jan 1876, d. 1927; WWI draft registration in Alameda Co.), and two daughters, Josephine Eugenia (1909-1976) and Mary Georgia (1911-2008). She was widowed at about 43 and lived another 57 years, in Piedmont, Berkeley and Oakland ([R4-S1], [R4-S2]).
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh
